summary.text: Nancy Murphy is a Democratic state representative from New Hampshire House District Hillsborough 12 who has served in the New Hampshire House of Representatives since 2022 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
She is a registered nurse who previously served in the House from 2018 to 2020.

paragraphs.text: Nancy Murphy was born in Cambridge, Massachusetts, and lives in Merrimack, New Hampshire.
She graduated from Mount Saint Joseph Academy in Brighton, Massachusetts, and earned a bachelor's degree in nursing from the Boston University School of Nursing in 1980.

Her career experience includes working as a registered nurse, primarily in pediatrics, mental health and child protection, and as a nurse coordinator for the state Division for Children, Youth and Families' foster care health program.
Murphy joined the board of directors of the New Hampshire Safe Water Alliance and became a member of New Hampshire Science and Public Health.
Murphy represented Hillsborough 21 in the New Hampshire House from 2018 to 2020 and returned in 2022, representing Hillsborough 12 since that election, according to Ballotpedia.
She was assigned to the Criminal Justice and Public Safety Committee for the 2019-2020 and 2023-2024 sessions.
